W.note: Pre-blurred cloud with only opacity/transform animating, asymmetric slow-in/release curves, focus ring, calm-mode toggle plus reduced-motion handling, polished dark page; glow is clear but fairly contained.

X.note: Pastel iridescent bloom with a soft overshoot and drifting glow is the most visibly ethereal, with good focus and reduced-motion, but it animates letter-spacing and blur filter and the resting button is low in contrast and affordance.

Y.note: Strong saturated gradient button with legible label and focus state; the hover white blob and hue shift is pleasant but less ethereal, and reduced-motion only shortens durations.

Z.note: Well-built dark page with solid focus and reduced-motion, but the hover change is faint across 1.6s transitions so it barely reads as dreamlike or as a clear affordance.
